data.name: Hilton Vallarta Riviera All-Inclusive Resort
data.address: Carr Barra De Navidad Km4.5, Zona Hotelera, Sur, 48390 Puerto Vallarta, Jal., Mexico
data.description:
Set on a private beach along the Pacific Ocean, this upscale all-inclusive resort is off Federal Highway 200. It's 19 km from Licenciado Gustavo Díaz Ordaz International Airport.
Featuring balconies and ocean views, the understated rooms and suites provide Wi-Fi, smart TVs and safes, plus minibars and Nespresso machines. Room service is available 24/7.
Multiple dining options include a buffet eatery, and seafood and tapas restaurants. There's also a cocktail bar and a swim-up bar. Other amenities consist of a spa, a gym, and 2 outdoor pools overlooking the ocean, as well as event space and parking. Children are welcome by prior arrangement.
